main_issue: Whether alcohol will be served at the shared-flat housewarming party, given Agent D's religious objection and Agent A's and Agent B's wish to serve drinks to guests.

A-B.evidence: B endorses A's cooler-box compromise (14) and backs A's objection to moving to a bar (24).

A-C.evidence: C is sympathetic to D and questions A's cooler plan (15); A rejects C's bar split (23); C's timed split (25) is not accepted by D, and C ends out of ideas (27).

A-D.evidence: A insists on the drinks and a cooler (11, 13); D refuses to host with alcohol served (12, 16); neither moves.

B-C.evidence: B calls A's cooler plan fair (14) while C doubts it (15); B rejects the bar move (24) and C concedes the point (25) but cannot find a solution (27).

B-D.evidence: B backs the cooler compromise (14) and objects to dropping alcohol because of guests (19, 24); D says alcohol at the party is not okay (16). They never address each other directly.

C-D.evidence: C checks D's concern (15) and proposes alternatives (20, 25); D appreciates the effort (21, 28), and C concedes D's objection (27).
